# Refund Timeline

Once your returned item is picked up and passes our quality check, we send your refund to your original payment method.

- Standard refunds take 5 to 7 business days after the quality check.
- UPI refunds are usually faster, 2 to 3 business days.
- Credit card and debit card refunds can take up to 10 business days, depending on your bank.

For cash on delivery orders, the refund goes to your bank account. Humein aapki bank details chahiye hongi.

# Payment Failed but Money Deducted

If money was deducted but your order was not placed, the amount is reversed automatically within 5 to 7 business days. You do not need to pay again.

If the amount is not reversed after 7 business days, contact support and share your transaction ID.

Paisa kat gaya ho toh dobara payment na karein, reversal apne aap ho jaata hai.

# Return Window

You can return most items within 7 days of delivery. The item must be unused, with tags attached and in its original packaging.

- Electronics can be returned within 7 days only if they are in the original box with all accessories.
- Innerwear, personal care items, and perishable goods cannot be returned.

Return request karne ke liye My Orders mein jaakar Return par click karein.

# Cancel an Order

You can cancel an order before it is shipped. Go to My Orders, select the order, and tap Cancel.

Once an order has been shipped it cannot be cancelled. Shipped hone ke baad order cancel nahi hota. You can refuse the delivery or return the item after it arrives.

Refunds for cancelled prepaid orders are processed within 3 to 5 business days.

# Delivery Charges

Delivery is free on orders above 499 rupees. For orders of 499 rupees or less, a delivery charge of 49 rupees applies.

499 rupees se upar ke orders par delivery free hai.

# Track Your Order

After your order ships, we send a tracking link by SMS and email. You can also go to My Orders and tap Track.

Tracking updates can take up to 24 hours to appear after shipping. Thoda time lag ho sakta hai.

# Payment Methods

We accept UPI, debit cards, credit cards, net banking, and wallets.

Cash on delivery is available for orders up to 5000 rupees, with a COD fee of 30 rupees.

If the amount is not reversed after 7 business days, contact support and share your transaction ID.

# Coupon Codes

Only one coupon can be used per order, and coupons cannot be combined. Coupons do not work on clearance items.

If a coupon is not applying, check the minimum order value and the expiry date.

# Login and Password Help

Forgot your password? Tap Login, then Forgot Password. We send an OTP to your registered mobile number.

For security reasons, the registered mobile number cannot be changed in the app. Please contact support to change it.
